description: Record a file's details: category, one-line summary, dates (YYYY-MM-DD: documentDate, dueAt, validUntil), the family members it concerns, and up to 12 labelled facts. Fields you send replace the current ones; fields you leave out are kept. Plannie's own document reading never overwrites what you set.

documentDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD: when the document was issued, taken or given

dueAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the next deadline, renewal or dose

facts.description: Up to 12 facts a parent would look up later, e.g. { "label": "Vaccine", "value": "TBE" }. Replaces the current list.

memberIds.description: Family member ids the document concerns (from get_members)

name: update_file_details
title: Update file details
